verdict.rationale: Postmark is a pure HTTP API email service with server-token authentication (no browser/UI dependency), official SDKs, a documented sandbox/test token for CI testing, batch endpoints, and TypeScript examples suited for scripted/automated pipelines — all naturally runnable headlessly in CI. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example or GitHub Actions integration doc, and no first-party statement confirming headless CI usage beyond inferring from API-only design.
